blocks.text: This chapter covered online research, digital literacy and intellectual property: the importance and types of online research; digital literacy skills of using technology, retrieving and evaluating information, creating content and staying safe; advanced search techniques; forming research questions and hypotheses; using digital resources; research ethics; and the types of intellectual property, patents, trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs and trade secrets, that protect creative and innovative work.

items: Search smartly, judge sources, ask clear questions, research ethically and respect intellectual property.
